extDescription.message: Open alphaXiv papers on arXiv as abstracts, PDFs, or experimental HTML. Keep versions, copy links, and use a shortcut.

commandOpenArxiv.message: Open the current paper on arXiv using your reading preferences

htmlNote.message: Only some paper versions have HTML.

dockDrag.message: Drag to move, or use the arrow keys

dockCompactHint.message: Open arXiv · Drag to move · Right-click to expand

storageNote.message: Preferences are saved in this browser

versionNote.message: Keep the version in the source link. Unversioned links open the latest paper.

emptyNote.message: Open a paper page, paste a reference, or enter a title or keywords.

savedPreferences.message: Saved. Opening and copying use your preferences.

saveFailed.message: Saving failed. Please select your preferences again.

openFailed.message: Opening failed. Refresh the paper page and try again.

copySucceeded.message: Copied the arXiv link using your version preference.

copyFailed.message: Copying failed. Keep this panel open and try again.

shortcutInstructions.message: Open chrome://extensions/shortcuts to configure the shortcut.

loadPreferencesFailed.message: Could not load preferences. Please reopen this panel.

loadPageFailed.message: Could not read the current page. Please reopen this panel.

dockOpenNew.message: Open arXiv $1 in a new tab

dockCopyFailed.message: Copying failed. Try again in the extension panel.

reloadExtension.message: Refresh this page to reload the extension.

invalidTab.message: Reopen the extension and try again.

unsupportedPage.message: Open an alphaXiv or arXiv paper first.

latestVersionNote.message: Open and copy the latest version of this paper.

invalidPaperInput.message: Check this reference, or enter a title or keywords (up to 300 characters).

paperInputLabel.message: Paper link, arXiv ID, title or keywords

paperInputPlaceholder.message: Link, arXiv ID, title or keywords

paperInputHelp.message: Paste a paper link, ID, arXiv DOI or Markdown link to open it directly. Enter a title or keywords to search.

inputNewTabNote.message: Entered papers open in a new tab. Input stays in this panel.

batchOpenFailed.message: Could not open the batch organizer. Please try again.

batchLocalNote.message: Fetch only on request · No draft saved

batchIntro.message: Turn a handful of paper references into a clean Markdown list.

batchInputHelp.message: One reference per line: paper links, arXiv IDs, arXiv DOIs, or Markdown links. Bulleted and numbered lists work too.

batchCurrentNote.message: Keep each explicit version. v2, v3, and an unversioned reference remain separate; matching versions are deduplicated.

batchLatestNote.message: Remove version suffixes and merge all references to the same paper. The exported link opens its latest version.

batchExportNote.message: Export includes unique, valid references in their original order. Duplicates and invalid lines are excluded.

batchEmptyDetail.message: Paste references to see valid papers, duplicates, and lines to fix.

batchFooter.message: Drafts and fetched details stay in this tab and clear on close or reload. Exported links point to arXiv abstract pages.

batchLineNumber.description: $1 is the original input line number.

batchInvalidDetail.message: Check this line. Use one supported paper URL, arXiv ID, arXiv DOI, or Markdown link.

batchDuplicateDetail.message: Matches line $1 under this version setting. Excluded from export.
batchDuplicateDetail.description: $1 is the line number of the first occurrence.

batchLimits.description: $1 is the reference limit, $2 is the character limit.

batchInputTooLong.message: This input exceeds $1 characters. Shorten it before exporting; no partial list is exported.

batchTooManyReferences.message: This input exceeds $1 nonblank lines. Split it into smaller lists before exporting.

batchLoadFailed.message: Could not load reading preferences. This tab is using default settings; your references can still be organized.

batchHasInvalid.message: Some lines need attention. You can fix them or export the valid references now.

batchReady.description: $1 is the number of unique references.

batchCopyFailed.message: Copy failed. Keep this tab active and try again, or download the Markdown file.

batchDownloaded.message: Markdown file requested. Check your browser's downloads.

batchDownloadFailed.message: Could not create the Markdown file. Try copying the list instead.

batchMetadataDisclosure.message: Only Fetch sends unique arXiv IDs to arXiv for paper details. Titles and authors stay in this tab.

batchMetadataProgress.message: Retrieving details: checked $1/$2 papers. Large lists may take a moment.

batchMetadataPermissionDenied.message: arXiv access wasn't granted. Your link list still works; click Fetch to try again.

batchMetadataTimeout.message: arXiv took too long to respond. Retry unavailable papers; your link list still works.

batchMetadataBusy.message: arXiv requests are busy. Retry shortly; your link list still works.

batchMetadataInvalidResponse.message: arXiv returned unusable details. Retry later; your link list still works.

batchMetadataNetworkFailed.message: Couldn't retrieve arXiv details. Retry unavailable papers; your link list still works.

batchMetadataCancelled.message: Retrieval cancelled. Details already fetched are kept in this tab.

batchMetadataReady.message: Paper details are ready. Markdown can use titles, and BibTeX is ready to import.

batchMetadataPartial.message: Details are incomplete. Markdown keeps ID labels for unavailable papers; BibTeX includes fetched papers only.

batchBibtexNote.message: BibTeX is generated from fetched arXiv metadata ($1/$2 papers). Unavailable papers are excluded.

batchBibtexCopied.message: Copied BibTeX for the fetched papers.

batchBibtexCopyFailed.message: Copy failed. Keep this tab active and retry, or download the .bib file.

batchBibtexDownloaded.message: BibTeX file requested. Check your browser's downloads, then import the .bib file into your reference manager.

batchBibtexDownloadFailed.message: Could not create the BibTeX file. Try copying the references instead.

searchInputNote.message: Review matching papers in a new tab.

searchNewTabNote.message: Search opens a results tab. Choose a paper there.

searchOpenFailed.message: Could not open arXiv search. Please try again.

searchInputPlaceholder.message: e.g. attention is all you need

searchDisclosure.message: Search sends this query to arXiv. Queries and results stay in this tab and clear on reload or close.

searchIdle.message: Enter a title or a few keywords to begin.

searchReady.message: Click Search to find matching papers on arXiv.

searchNeedsPermission.message: Click Search to allow access to arXiv and run this query.

searchInvalidQuery.message: Enter a title or keywords using 1–300 characters.

searchPermissionDenied.message: arXiv access was not granted. Click Search to try again.

searchTimeout.message: arXiv took too long to respond. Please try again.

searchBusy.message: arXiv requests are busy. Please try again shortly.

searchInvalidResponse.message: arXiv returned unusable results. Please try again later.

searchNetworkFailed.message: Could not search arXiv. Check your connection and try again.

searchCancelled.message: Search cancelled. You can edit the query and search again.

searchEmpty.message: No matching papers. Try a different title or fewer keywords.

searchResultsReady.message: Results are ready. Choose a paper and reading format below.

searchRefine.message: Only the first 200 results are available here. Refine your query to find more specific papers.

searchLoadFailed.message: Could not load reading preferences. This tab is using default settings.

searchHtmlNote.message: HTML is experimental and may be unavailable for some paper versions.
